question: Can a certified FD&C (subpart B) straight color batch be used in cosmetics, and what must it meet?
answer:
A certified FD&C (subpart B) straight color batch may be used in cosmetics if it meets the requirements of 21 CFR 82.1050 and 21 CFR 82.2050. 

The batch must conform to the requirements of § 82.5 and the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color. This includes ensuring that the color is suitable for use in cosmetics and that the batch is certified for use in cosmetics under the provisions of this part. 

The available regulatory sources do not provide enough information to answer this.
